name: Sheraton Abu Dhabi Hotel & Resort
description: This 5-star hotel and beach resort in Abu Dhabi city center is located on a private beach within walking distance of business and shopping districts. It has outdoor pools, a well-equipped gym, and 6 food outlets. The Sheraton Abu Dhabi Hotel & Resort offers newly-renovated luxury hotel rooms including 2-bedroom hotel suites and family hotel rooms. Each room has a marble bathroom and a private balcony with views over the city or the Arabian Gulf, being a hotel with a beach. This beach hotel in Abu Dhabi serves a range of cuisine and a variety of dining venues including Le Bistrot, a French restaurant, Tavern, the legendary British pub in Abu Dhabi, all-day dining buffet restaurant Flavors, and a pool bar. Guests can relax at the hotel's outdoor swimming pools, which are shaded by palm trees. There is also a sauna and a steam room for relaxation. The fully-equipped gym features modern cardiovascular equipment and weights. An indoor squash court and an outdoor tennis court located at the rooftop of the health club are also available for guests. Providing timeless charm, the event venues and hotel function rooms have been part of generations and generations of memorable occasions forging deep emotional connections to the Abu Dhabi residents. The Sheraton Abu Dhabi Hotel & Resort is within walking distance of the newly developed Corniche Park and provides easy access to Sheikh Zayed Tunnel.
